Report Description
TWO MONTHS PRIOR TO THE INCIDENT DATE, THE GAS METER AT A PRIVATE RESIDENCE WAS ISOLATED AND TAGGED OUT. THE EVENING PRIOR TO THE INCIDENT DATE, THE OWNER REPORTED TO HAVE SMELLED GAS AND THAT THE HOUSE'S GAS ALARM WAS SOUNDING. THE OWNER LEFT THE LOCATION AND ALL OCCUPANTS SPENT THE NIGHT ELSEWHERE. THE DATE OF THE INCIDENT, THE OWNER RETURNED TO THE LOCATION AND DISCOVERED THAT A FIRE HAD OCCURRED AND A PLASTIC WATER PIPE HAD MELTED, ALLOWING WATER TO PUT THE FIRE OUT. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT RESPONDED AND THEN REQUESTED ASSISTANCE FROM THE GAS COMPANY TO SECURE THE METER. GAS COMPANY TECHNICIANS RESPONDED AND SECURED THE METER. CALLER IS REPORTING THE INCIDENT BECAUSE THE DAMAGE VALUE IS EXPECTED TO EXCEED $50,000, ALTHOUGH MOST OF THE DAMAGE IS WATER DAMAGE.

Report Description- ON 27 DECEMBER 2023, USCG SECTOR ANCHORAGE RECEIVED A REPORT OF A FIRE ONBOARD THE 410-FOOT MOTOR VESSEL (M/V) GENIUS STAR 11 (FLAG: PANAMA). - THERE ARE 19 PERSONNEL ONBOARD WITH NO REPORTED INJURIES. - THE VESSEL IS CARRYING 1.8 MILLION KG OF LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES. - THE VESSEL SUSTAINED A FIRE IN THEIR CARGO HOLD #1 FROM THE LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES IN ROUGH SEAS. - THE CO2 SYSTEM IN CARGO HOLD #1 WAS FULLY EXHAUSTED AND THE FIRE WAS EXTINGUISHED. - HOURS LATER CARGO HOLD #2 SUSTAINED A FIRE DUE TO LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES AND ROUGH SEAS. - THE CREW IS CURRENTLY FIGHTING THE FIRE IN CARGO HOLD #2. - M/V GENIUS STAR 11 IS ENROUTE TO SECURE TO A MOORING BALL NW OF HOG ISLAND, SW OF DUTCH HARBOR TO ALLOW UNITS TO GET ON SCENE, ASSIST, AND ASSESS THE SITUATION. - THE ESTIMATED TIME OF ARRIVAL IS AT 0330 ET ON 29 DECEMBER 2023. - THE VESSEL HAS CONTRACTED SALVAGE COMPANIES. - USCG MARINE SAFETY DETACHMENT DUTCH HARBOR PERSONNEL ARE ON SCENE. - USCG D17 EXTERNAL AFFAIRS ARE MAKING NOTIFICATIONS TO DUTCH HARBOR OFFICIALS. - THERE IS A POSSIBLE POLLUTION AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT. - A COAST GUARD FIXED WINGED AIRCRAFT FLEW OVERHEAD AND IS STANDING BY FOR ANOTHER FLY OVER. - COAST GUARD CUTTER ALEX HALEY HAS BEEN TASKED TO MEET THE VESSEL. - THERE ARE CURRENTLY 35-40 KNOT WINDS WITH AN IMPENDING WINTER STORM ESTIMATED TO BE OVERHEAD ON 01 JANUARY 2024. - THERE WILL BE A FOLLOW-ON CIC ON 29 DECEMBER 2023 AT 1030Z / 0530 ET
